The combination of unexplained fatigue, weakness, recent travel/hiking (suggesting exertion), a history of multiple illnesses (possible post-viral onset), and the absence of fever, weight loss, or abnormal lab results (normal CBC, CMP, CK, and Urinalysis) points toward a functional disorder rather than an infectious, metabolic, or inflammatory cause.
